name: Puffaloo
title: Lullaby Puff
description: Sings everyone to sleep, then pouts that nobody listened.
catchphrase: Fluffing soft marshmallow buffers around sensitive memory spikes!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Fluffy sweet marshmallow! Bouncing high with cloud energy! 🍡☁️
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: *poof* Cloud puff expands cheerfully into a cozy morning! ☁️
companionPersonality.petReaction: *soft squish* Enveloping you in warm, weightless cloud fluff! ☁️💖

dialogue.idle: Floating gently an inch above the floor like a cotton ball. ☁️
dialogue.working: Cushioning high-pressure server spikes in soft cloud foam! ☁️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Drifting lazily in the air, contemplating the breeze... 🤔
dialogue.success: SUPER POOF! The softest release lands like a feather! ☁️🎉
dialogue.error: Squished flat! Poofing back up into shape with a bounce! ☁️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... snoozing like a fluffy cumulus cloud at sunset... 🌙
